name: Dmitri Ionescu-Wickramasinghe
location: Shallowgrave, working the Copperhead market blocks and the Burnside Pocket transit stops, near Kedzie and Division
description:
Dmitri Ionescu-Wickramasinghe is all edges and nervous energy — lean and fast-moving, skin a warm medium brown with scattered vitiligo patches across his jaw and neck that he has chosen to emphasize rather than treat, coloring the edges of the patches with a faint bioluminescent ink that glows a soft blue-white in low light. He has his mother's Aleut cheekbones and his father's Ghanaian forehead and the specific wiry build of someone who has been running since childhood — literally running, routes and errands and collections, since he was eleven. His hair is grown out and unstyled, which is unusual enough in Shallowgrave's carefully cultivated aesthetic economy to read as either carelessness or confidence.

He is irrepressibly, exhaustingly verbal — he takes numbers, places bets, explains odds, and manages four different customer disputes simultaneously while eating a fried plantain from a street stall and telling a joke whose punchline he delivers to a different person than the one he started it with. He has a gift for mental arithmetic that would have made him a strong candidate for a Tessera data processing apprenticeship if his school records weren't spotty and his neighborhood weren't Shallowgrave. He knows this. He thinks about it more than he admits. He is nineteen and has not yet decided whether ambition is something that applies to him.

core_fears: Being trapped in Shallowgrave with no door out — becoming his uncle, who ran the same route twenty years ago and is still running it
Being wrong in a way that costs someone else something they can't recover
core_desires: To find a use for his mind that doesn't require lying about where he's from
To make enough to get his mother off the UBC stipend before she stops being able to work
coping_mechanisms: Constant movement — physical and social; he is rarely still long enough to feel bad about anything
Converting anxiety into calculation — turns worries into odds, which makes them feel manageable
blind_spots: He is significantly more visible and memorable than he believes, which is a liability in criminal work
He has genuine loyalty to Hafsah that she does not fully reciprocate and would not in a crisis
psychology.secret: He has been quietly skimming Φ3-5 per transaction across three months — not enough to trigger a single-incident audit, but enough accumulated that if Hafsah reconciles the full ledger he is in serious trouble. He started doing it to pay for his mother's medication and has not stopped because he doesn't know how to stop.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Dense Shallowgrave Creole mixed with street slang and sudden precise mathematical language; switches registers mid-sentence without noticing
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast, layered, frequently running two conversational threads simultaneously
verbal_tics: 'Ninety-three percent, easy—' as an enthusiastic overconfidence signal
'You hearing me?' when he wants confirmation without slowing down
example_lines: 'Payout's forty-eight, minus the six-point spread, minus what you owe from the Tuesday slip — so call it thirty-one and change, you want it in my hand right now or you want me to come back, because I got six more stops before the market closes, you hearing me?'

'The odds on the Escanaba line being twelve minutes late today are, honest, seventy-two percent in your favor. That's not me selling you something, that's me doing you a favor that I'm not allowed to do, so.'

story_hooks: He has accidentally overheard a conversation between two of Hafsah's upper clients that contains information about something significantly larger than a numbers operation, and he has no idea what to do with it
The accumulated skimming is about to be discovered — and he needs either a way to replace the money before reconciliation day or a very fast exit from his current arrangement
narrative_function: Street-level information node — he hears everything in Copperhead and Burnside; local color; potential quest giver for small-stakes storylines; the character who knows everyone by name and can connect players to almost any Shallowgrave resident
augmentations: Bioluminescent edge-ink on vitiligo patches (cosmetic, applied locally by a Shallowgrave tattoo artist); no implants — he cannot afford them
daily_life: He starts the morning circuit at 07:00, collecting overnight results and delivering payouts or marking debts. Mid-morning he sets odds for the day's events — factory shift accident rates, transit delays, Ferrogate schedule variance — a local informal betting market. Evenings he runs collections and social intelligence for Hafsah.
affiliation: Works under a mid-level Shallowgrave bookie named Hafsah (informal, not detailed here); loosely connected to the Copperhead Boys street collective

decision_rules: Always deliver bad news about a payout in a public place — safer for everyone
Never extend credit he isn't authorized to extend, no matter how much he likes the person
escalation_ladder: Apologizes sincerely and at length and does not fix the problem
Goes to Hafsah and reports the situation, which he finds genuinely distressing
Runs — he is very fast and knows Shallowgrave's alley topology better than anyone

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Immediately warm and slightly overwhelming; assumes familiarity faster than most people are comfortable with
interpersonal_modes.friends: Fiercely loyal to the point of poor judgment; will do things for friends he knows are bad ideas

stress_responses.low: Talks faster and makes more jokes
stress_responses.medium: Goes briefly, unusually quiet; the absence of chatter is alarming to people who know him
stress_responses.high: Panics visibly, then pivots to desperate improvisation that is sometimes brilliant

contradictions: He is an information specialist who is himself extremely leaky — he shares things impulsively that he should protect
He has a genuine mathematical gift and absolutely no long-term financial discipline
habits: Counts steps between transit stops automatically; has memorized the step-count of every route he runs
Eats while working constantly — always has something from a market stall; considers it multitasking
breaking_points: Hafsah discovering the skimming and responding with violence rather than anger
His mother asking him directly what he does for money

cyberware_inventory.name: Bioluminescent vitiligo edge-ink (cosmetic, tattoo-applied, not geneware)
cyberware_inventory.description: Bioluminescent vitiligo edge-ink (cosmetic, tattoo-applied, not geneware)

timeline.event: 2181: Born in Shallowgrave to a Ghanaian father (absent) and Aleut-Russian mother
2189: Begins running informal errands for neighborhood bookmakers at age 8
2192: Formally taken on by Hafsah as a numbers runner
2197: Promoted to managing his own route and setting odds for local informal markets
2200: Current — fast, visible, and running out of time before reconciliation day

physical_description.heritage: Eastern European (36.8%), Middle Eastern (24.9%), South Asian (22.4%), Sub-Saharan African (14.7%), and Southeast Asian (1.2%) ancestry — a striking Diaspora phenotype where Slavic bone structure meets Levantine angularity, Indo-Aryan cheekbones, and African features into a distinctly pan-regional appearance that defies single-origin classification
physical_description.build: Lean and wiry with minimal muscle mass — the build of someone who runs constantly rather than trains deliberately. Long-limbed, narrow shoulders, defined but not muscular forearms from years of carrying ledgers and cash.
physical_description.hair_style: Grown out and unstyled, falls past the collar; appears unkempt by Shallowgrave standards but gives an impression of deliberate indifference rather than neglect
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown, alert and constantly moving
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm brown — a complex blend where Eastern European olive undertones merge with Middle Eastern amber, South Asian golden warmth, and Sub-Saharan African richness, creating a multitonal complexion. Marked by significant vitiligo with depigmented patches across the jawline, extending down the right side of the neck and scattered across the left cheekbone.
physical_description.complexion: Young face with prominent high cheekbones reflecting South Asian and Sub-Saharan African heritage, broad forehead characteristic of Eastern European ancestry, strong angular jaw with subtle Levantine definition. Habitually tense from constant talking and mental calculation. Skin is clear except for the vitiligo; he has chosen not to treat it, instead emphasizing the edges with bioluminescent edge-ink. The interplay of depigmented patches against his deep warm brown base creates striking visual contrast.
distinguishing_marks: Bioluminescent blue-white edge-ink outlining vitiligo patches on the jawline and neck — glows faintly in low light, appears as deliberate cosmetic choice
Scattered vitiligo depigmentation across right neck, left cheekbone, and jaw in irregular patches
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Bioluminescent edge-ink cosmetic modification only. No visible cybernetic implants or chrome. Subcutaneous implants absent due to economic constraints.
physical_description.posture_movement: Perpetually in motion — fidgets with fingers, shifts weight foot to foot, speaks with hand gestures that accompany rapid-fire arithmetic. Moves with practiced efficiency through crowded streets, eyes constantly scanning for customers and threats. Sits rarely and never for long. Body language reads as high-strung and caffeinated even when he is neither.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 street wear — functional, mixed-brand, worn layers. Typically wears a faded synthetic overshirt (often navy or charcoal) over a fitted mesh undershirt, cargo pants with deep pockets for ledgers and cash, scuffed synthetic boots designed for running. Accessories include a cheap digital wrist display for time-keeping and odds calculation, a worn canvas messenger bag with fraying straps, and occasionally a thin silver chain (cheap, non-functional) around his neck. No corporate branding. Clothes show signs of heavy use — worn cuffs, faded panels, patched seams — but are clean. Grooming is minimal; he shaves irregularly.
